items.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE original wide 16:9 illustration for the chapter opener of a Japanese junior-high textbook, topic: enriching imagination through reading. In a bright school library by a large window, three Japanese first-year junior-high students in plain school uniforms sit comfortably reading books and smiling with thoughtful, imaginative expressions. One looks briefly toward the sky outside the window as if picturing the story. Clear central composition, soft afternoon light, simple shelves and plants, a small friendly cat peeking beside a chair for gentle humor. Warm soft hand-drawn watercolor with rounded outlines, muted blue/green/orange, not photorealistic. Book pages and spines are plain or abstract color shapes with absolutely NO letters, numbers, paragraph lines or logos. No readable text anywhere, no speech-balloon writing, no famous character designs, copied textbook art or watermark. A single finished scene, no variant grid.

items.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. ONE original wide 16:9 illustration for a Japanese junior-high literature textbook, introduction to a poem about a kappa and a frog. Central main scene: a gentle moonlit marsh with lily pads and reeds, where ONE friendly original green kappa with a small water dish on its head and a simple turtle-like shell plays peacefully on the water with ONE ordinary green frog. The kappa makes a small playful splash and the frog hops toward a lily pad; convey sound and rhythmic movement VISUALLY with ripples and droplets, never written sound effects. Charming, rounded, softly hand-painted educational art, clear uncluttered blue-green nighttime scene with warm moonlight, no frightening monster or violence. Two Japanese junior-high readers in plain uniforms may appear as small separate foreground readers of the illustrated scene, not participants in the marsh. Absolutely no text, Japanese characters, numerals, printed lines, labels, logos, watermarks or copyrighted modern character appearance. No copies of existing book illustrations. Single finished image, no grid.
